notes: Fair puzzle: each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and every constraint is findable in the chat.

The allergy is never named outright. A new player has to infer it from 'the satay incident' plus Brooke's list (satay, dipping sauce, crushed toppings). Brooke's line makes it clear enough, but someone who skims could read it as a dislike rather than an allergy.
Brooke's no-fried constraint is indirect (climbing plus a fried lunch story). It is fair, but it is the easiest one to miss, which makes Teak Door the strongest trap.
Maya's budget is 'more than a few bucks', so it is open to interpretation; Orchid Row's 'change left over from a ten' backs up the $ tier nicely.
